source.title: Lurgan Mail, 21 May 1949, p. 4 ("Rural Council Elections: Seven Unopposed in Moira")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'With seven nominations for seven seats, there will not be a contest in Moira Rural District' (Lurgan Mail, 21 May 1949, p. 4), which lists the members of the new council by division

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Moira rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There was no contest: seven nominations were received for seven seats. The News-Letter names the one new member, R. Malcolmson. All seven members, by division, from the Lurgan Mail, 21 May 1949, p. 4 (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
